    • approach

      public static float approach(float current, float target, float smoothing, float deltaSeconds)
      Frame-rate independent approach towards a target.

      A plain current += (target - current) * 0.1f moves faster at higher frame rates, which is why HUD animations feel different on different machines. This compensates using the frame time.

      Parameters:
      smoothing - fraction of the remaining distance covered per second, 0..1
      deltaSeconds - time since the previous frame
